neighbours.label: A word adding a further item or domain after one is named ('not only academically, but in', 'used in politics and also in', 'soups, salads', 'at home, in your car'); the first item on its own stays quiet.
fire: It helps not only financially, but in his family life.
They are widely used in medicine and also in farming.
Toss them into stews, stir-fries, and other meals.
Keep a torch at home, in your bag, and at work.
It not only harms the fish. It also harms the people.
She excels not just at math, but has something else as well.
He works in sales and also in training.
Pack it for picnics, hikes, and other trips.
quiet: It helps him in his family life most days.
They are widely used in medicine these days.
Toss them into a stew at the end of cooking.
Keep a torch at home for a power cut.
It harms the fish in the river each year.
She excels at math and enjoys it every day.
He works in sales at a small firm.
Pack it for a picnic in the park.

short: word adding a further item or domain
notes: Probes: 0.24-0.67; single-item sentences 0.00-0.01. The peak token varies (' in', a noun, ' else'). The near misses have one item only, so they differ in length too.
